node.name: Reviewing All Training
node.description: The effectiveness of relevant cybersecurity education and training is persistently reviewed, including at least general training for all employees, role-specific training for employees in high risk roles, training for development and engineering staff on secure software delivery, and training for staff involved with incident response or disaster recovery.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Logging Changes
node.description: Modifications to the cloud service offering are logged and monitored.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Redeploying vs Modifying
node.description: Changes to machine-based information resources are executed through the redeployment of version controlled resources rather than direct modification wherever reasonable.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Reviewing Change Procedures
node.description: The effectiveness of documented change management procedures is persistently reviewed.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Validating Throughout Deployment
node.description: Persistent testing and validation of changes throughout deployment is automated.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Defining Functionality and Privileges
node.description: The functionality and privileges for infrastructure and services are strictly defined.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

b.statement: **Optional:** Automated services are used to persistently assess the security of all machine-based information resources and automatically enforce their intended operational state.

c.statement: Automated services are used to persistently assess the security of all machine-based information resources and automatically enforce their intended operational state.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Implementing Best Practices
node.description: The use and configuration of third-party machine-based information resources is persistently compared against the original provider's best practices and guidance.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Minimizing Attack Surface
node.description: Machine-based information resources are persistently reviewed to ensure they have a minimal attack surface and that lateral movement is minimized if compromised.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Optimizing for Availability
node.description: Machine-based information resources are persistently reviewed to ensure they are appropriately optimized for high availability and rapid recovery.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Restricting Network Traffic
node.description: Machine-based information resources are persistently reviewed to ensure they are appropriately configured to limit inbound and outbound network traffic.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Reviewing Protections
node.description: The effectiveness of protection against denial of service attacks and other unwanted activity for machine-based information resources is persistently reviewed.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Using Logical Networking
node.description: Logical networking and related capabilities are used and persistently reviewed to enforce traffic flow controls.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Automating Account Management
node.description: The lifecycle and privileges of all accounts, roles, and groups are securely managed using automation.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Adopting Passwordless Methods
node.description: Secure passwordless methods are used for user authentication and authorization when feasible, otherwise strong passwords with phishing-resistant MFA is used.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Ensuring Least Privilege
node.description: Identity and access management measures are used and persistently reviewed to ensure each user or device can only access the resources they need.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Authorizing Just-in-Time
node.description: A least-privileged, role and attribute-based, and just-in-time security authorization model is used and persistently reviewed for all user and non-user accounts and services.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Securing Non-User Authentication
node.description: Appropriately secure authentication methods are used and persistently reviewed for non-user accounts and services.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Responding to Suspicious Activity
node.description: Accounts with privileged access are disabled or otherwise secured in response to suspicious activity.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Generating After Action Reports
node.description: Incident after action reports are generated and lessons learned are persistently incorporated.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Reviewing Incident Response Procedures
node.description: The effectiveness of documented incident response procedures is persistently reviewed.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Reviewing Past Incidents
node.description: Past incidents are persistently reviewed for patterns or vulnerabilities that were not previously apparent or identified.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

b.statement: **Optional:** A least-privileged, role and attribute-based, and just-in-time access authorization model is used and persistently reviewed for access to log data based on organizationally defined data sensitivity.

c.statement: A least-privileged, role and attribute-based, and just-in-time access authorization model is used and persistently reviewed for access to log data based on organizationally defined data sensitivity.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Evaluating Configurations
node.description: The configuration of machine-based information resources, especially infrastructure as code, is persistently evaluated and tested.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Logging Event Types
node.description: A list of information resources and event types that will be logged, monitored, and audited is maintained and persistently reviewed to ensure these activities occur.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Operating SIEM Capability
node.description: A Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) or similar system(s) is used and persistently reviewed for centralized, tamper-resistant logging of events, activities, and changes.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Reviewing Logs
node.description: Logs are persistently reviewed and audited.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Generating Inventories
node.description: Authoritative sources are used to automatically generate real-time inventories of all information resources when needed.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Reviewing Executive Support
node.description: Executive support for achieving the provider's security goals is persistently reviewed and demonstrated.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Reviewing Investments in Security
node.description: The effectiveness of the provider's investments in achieving security goals is persistently reviewed.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Reviewing Security in the SDLC
node.description: The effectiveness of building security and privacy considerations into the Software Development Lifecycle and aligning with CISA Secure By Design principles is persistently reviewed.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Reviewing Vulnerability Disclosures
node.description: The effectiveness of the provider's vulnerability disclosure program is persistently reviewed.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Aligning Backups with Objectives
node.description: The alignment of machine-based information resource backups with defined recovery objectives is persistently reviewed.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Aligning Recovery Plan
node.description: The alignment of recovery plans with defined recovery objectives is persistently reviewed.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Reviewing Recovery Objectives
node.description: The desired Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) are persistently reviewed for alignment with the provider's business needs and capabilities.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Testing Recovery Capabilities
node.description: The capability to recover from incidents and contingencies aligned with defined recovery objectives is persistently tested.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Mitigating Supply Chain Risk
node.description: Persistently identify, review, and mitigate potential supply chain risks.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Monitoring Supply Chain Risk
node.description: Third party software information resources are automatically monitored for upstream vulnerabilities using mechanisms that may include contractual notification requirements or active monitoring services.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Automating Configuration Management
node.description: The configuration of machine-based information resources is managed using automation and persistently reviewed for drift.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Automating Secret Management
node.description: Management, protection, and regular rotation of digital keys, certificates, and other secrets is automated and persistently reviewed.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.

node.name: Evaluating and Improving Security
node.description: Implement improvements based on persistent evaluation of information resources for opportunities to improve security.

updated_log.comment: Revisited and baselined against the Consolidated Rules for 2026.
